Confirming I am the economic buyer for this evaluation. High level notes to keep everyone aligned: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@finovo.com (Bethany Zhou) — preferred PO terms: net45, but can consider net30 for pilot.
- Legal contact: legal@finovo.com (in-house counsel).
- Primary decision criteria for execs: 1) predictable unit economics (we want an upper bound on per-token spend under burst loads), 2) contractual SLAs for availability, 3) data handling (we cannot store un-encrypted logs outside our tenancy), 4) clear escalation path / runbook.

On SOC2: we expect the vendor to provide an SOC2 summary and an S3 link to the full report under an NDA. Sophie — can your team share the NDA template?

Timeline: target procurement review week of 11/16 with legal sign-off by 11/23 if everything looks good. Pilot deployment (limited) in early Dec.
